title: Mobile Top-Up Orders and Paloma Rewards Points
content:
Whether a delivered Mobile Top-Up order earns Paloma Rewards points, and how many, is set by the member's tier.

| Tier | Mobile Top-Up orders earn points | Points per delivered Mobile Top-Up order |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | No | 0 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | Yes | 2 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | Yes | 3 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | Yes | 4 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | Yes | 5 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | Yes | 6 |

## Points of judgement

- On Paloma Rewards Blue, top-up earning is not enabled, so a delivered Mobile Top-Up order earns no points.
- On every other tier each delivered order earns the fixed figure shown for the tier, one award per order.
- Hypothetical illustration: a member on Paloma Rewards Gold with three delivered Mobile Top-Up orders earns 3 points on each order, 9 points across the three.
